data.long_meaning: Farwaaz is an Arabic name derived from the word ‘farwaa’ which means to protect or guard. This name is a reminder of the protective nature of Allah, who shields and safeguards His believers. The name Farwaaz carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farwaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
